sections.label: ✨ Improve
items: The card of a Brucebase mark on MusicBrainz (events and works) no longer lies over the link's preview: hovering a marked cell's link opens the card and, a moment later, the link's preview with its "Finding" box. The card now moves to the right of them when the window has room, else below them.

sections.label: 🚀 Feature
items: MusicBrainz works: marks from the Brucebase feed (BruceParser 0.27.0, feed 1.8), on the Work cell of an artist's or area's works and beside a work page's Brucebase link (after the page's press also in its "Sidebar" card). ❌ ⚓ "Brucebase link reaches nothing": the link names a page the wiki does not have, or an anchor its page does not have; the card names where it likely should go (the nine works that link the renamed Greetings sessions page get its new …-nj-studio-sessions page, King's Rock gets #kingsrock). ⚠️ ⇉ "Two works link one Brucebase song", with the other work in the card. ⚠️ ≉ "Work title differs from its Brucebase song": case, quotes, dashes and the wiki's "( - Artist - )" after a cover's title do not count, and one of the work's aliases may be the song's title. 14 works in the run of 2026-11-19. Each mark has its own switch in ⚙️ Settings → ⚠️ Findings, on by default; "Read the Brucebase feed on MusicBrainz too (events and works)" turns all of it off.
